title: Feature catalogue for /frontend (its CONTRACTS.md 6.1b), generated from plan.json requirements
description: Exactly /frontend's format: a JSON array, nothing else. Written only by exec.py (plan instantiate, amend, catalogue) to profile.paths.feature_catalogue (default <state>/feature-catalogue.json). One entry per requirement with surface 'ui', in plan order; id is the requirement id, which the UI renders as data-feature. status_expected is omitted when the requirement's is null.
